collection.title: VW Polo 1994 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Polo 1994 to 2001 model requires a 19" wiper blade for both the drivers and the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle with the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style of wiper blades. We also have rear blade for this Polo, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
